title: elastic onramp controller and tenant rate smoothing
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Motivation: sudden tenant traffic spikes cause the autoscaler and warm pools to oscillate (overshoot + reactive cold-starts) for certain distributions. This PR introduces an "Onramp Controller" and a tenant-level "rate smoothing" layer to make ramp behavior deterministic and safe without reducing steady-state throughput. Key ideas: 1) Onramp Controller (control plane) tracks tenant surge episodes and applies a configurable 'onramp_rate' policy that caps how quickly tenant concurrency/slot allocation can grow per-minute, with a short safety cooldown window that prevents immediate retries. 2) Tenant Rate Smoothing (runtime shim) smooths request rate signals emitted to the autoscaler and the cluster allocator by applying an exponential-jittered moving average; this reduces noisy utilization spikes from malformed client retry patterns. 3) Telemetry: new metrics for monitoring (tenant_onramp_state gauge, tenant_onramp_ramp_rate p95/p99, tenant_smoothed_utilization gauge, onramp_events_total counter). Implementation summary: - control plane controller under pkg/controller/onramp implements CRD-driven OnrampPolicy and reconciles per-tenant tokens. - runtime hook in pkg/scheduler/rate_limiter publishes smoothed signals instead of raw instantaneous qps. - config knobs in config/defaults.yaml and CRD schema allow per-tenant overrides and global emergency bypass for SRE. Backwards compatibility: default policies are conservative (disabled by default for existing tenants). Rollout plan: staged rollout to Dedicated staging clusters, canary two high-traffic tenants, enable global default after 2 weeks of telemetry with guardrails. Testing: unit + e2e tests included; load test harness script added. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked in ENG-8642 - [x] CRD + API changes - [x] Controller + runtime change - [x] Unit tests - [x] E2E onramp scenario - [x] Telemetry dashboards updated - [x] Migration notes and rollout plan Documentation: docs/observability/onramp-metrics.md and runbook notes included. Impact: reduces autoscaler oscillation and warm-pool churn in tests by ~28% tail utilization under bursty arrivals. See perf/tenantsim output attached. Notes: keep the 'emergency_bypass' feature guarded behind a gate; policy values tuned after two experiments.

merge_outcome: Merged by Diego Ramirez using squash merge. Commit message: 'controller: onramp controller + runtime smoothing (ENG-8642)'. Release notes appended to CHANGELOG under 'Dedicated Capacity & Autoscaling'.
release_notes: Introduces an optional Onramp Controller and tenant rate smoothing to reduce autoscaler oscillation during sudden tenant spikes. New CRD (OnrampPolicy) and telemetry metrics. Disabled by default for existing tenants; operator-controlled rollout required.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature via CRD in staging first. Observe tenant_smoothed_utilization and onramp_events_total. If anomalies occur, set emergency_bypass=true for the affected tenant and open SUP-1294.
performance_summary: In internal tenancy-sim experiments the change reduced warm-pool churn and 99th-percentile allocation latency by ~28% under synthetic burst traces (tenantsim output included in artifacts).
testing_summary: Added unit tests for reconciliation, scheduler signal smoothing, and an e2e test that drives a synthetic spike to validate gradual ramp behavior. Load script scripts/perf/tenantsim.sh included for reproducing experiments.
migration_instructions: CRD creation: apply deploy/manifests/onramp-crd.yaml. Existing tenants are opt-out by default. To enable for a tenant: create OnrampPolicy with onramp_rate and cooldowns. Rollback by deleting the OnrampPolicy or setting emergency_bypass=true.
security_considerations: No new network surface. CRD is namespaced; only operators can set emergency_bypass. Reviewed by Priya Shah.
changelog_section: Dedicated: Add optional Onramp Controller and tenant rate smoothing to improve autoscaler stability during tenant spikes. (ENG-8642)
